name: Devon Scone
desc: Split while warm, clotted cream first, then strawberry jam on top. That's the Devon way. Restores 120 HP.

name: Scrumpy
desc: Cloudy farmhouse cider from a Devon orchard, pressed from apples with names like Slack-ma-Girdle. Restores 8 PP to every move.

name: Turned Coat
desc: Pixie-led on the moor? Old Devon folk turned their coats inside out to break the spell. A little patch of inside-out tweed, for luck.

name: Drake's Drum
desc: A copy of the snare drum Drake took round the world. The legend says beat it when England is in danger and he will come back up Plymouth Sound.

name: Clotted Cream
desc: Rich milk warmed slowly for hours and left to cool, so the cream rises into a thick golden crust. A spoon stands up in it.

name: Stamp Book
desc: A letterboxer's notebook for the stamps from boxes hidden on Dartmoor. Some pages are inky, some are boggy, all are proudly earned.
